'''Liskran Dulce''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who was the [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] [[Atlee Thanda]], the leader of the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Thanda clan]]. At some point during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Dulce traveled with Thanda aboard the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] [[Scourge (yacht)|''Scourge'']] to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Besh gate]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]], to await the arrival of the [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Prit Kessek]], a courier who had been hired to transport some [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for Thanda. However, [[Skinchanger|Kessek's starship]] was hijacked by a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] that had been sent to capture Thanda and the spacers arrived at Besh gate in Kessek's place. The spacers transferred onto the ''Scourge'' and after engaging Dulce in combat, took custody of Thanda.
